correctness.rationale: The law of total variance splits n equal branch paths into bounded within-path variances ℓ(ℓ+2)/12 and variance of branch means. Strict convexity in each mean maximizes at c_v±ℓ/2, and equality forces every branch to be straight with slope ±1. The anchored core Lipschitz polytope has integral vertices by incidence-matrix total unimodularity. Expansion gives the exact sign-vector/core-vertex optimization for all ℓ. Balanced signs alone survive beyond the stated cutoff by leading-coefficient and integer covariance gaps; their optimal covariance equals finite Kantorovich–Rubinstein W1 between balanced signed vertex masses. The β bounds are attained by K_n and uniquely P_n because all consecutive ordered potential gaps must equal one. The eventual P_n dominance and exact clique formula follow. Independently checked n=3,4,5 clique ℓ=2 with exact Fraction arithmetic, obtaining 8/3,35/12,212/75 and matching the closed formula.
